themes: Approved-credit SLA: issue within 11 calendar days (billing/refunds.md:3-3)
Partial-refund identity preservation: retain the original invoice identifier (billing/refunds.md:3-3)
Unapproved-request handling: no deadline commitment exists (billing/refunds.md:3-3)

citations.note: Defines the approval deadline, invoice-identifier rule, and absence of an unapproved-request deadline.

recipes: To process an approved credit, track issuance against an 11-calendar-day deadline (billing/refunds.md:3-3).
To process a partial refund, retain the original invoice identifier; for an unapproved request, communicate that no deadline is promised (billing/refunds.md:3-3).

themes: Keep delay computation pure and side-effect free

citations.note: Defines the clamp, 7-second step schedule, and no-side-effects contract.

recipes: Compute delay as 7 * min(max(attempt, 0), 4).
Expected values: attempt 0→0, 1→7, 2→14, 3→21, 4+→28.
Unit-test boundary cases such as -1, 0, 1, 3, 4, and a large attempt.
Use the returned seconds in an external retry mechanism; keep this helper free of I/O and timing operations.

citations.note: Defines stored-record format, event numbering, and restart-readability requirement.

recipes: To record job history, append one JSONL event at a time and assign the next increasing integer within that job.
To recover after restart, read the persisted finished records and resume from the job's existing event history.

themes: Preserve Unicode for user-facing display labels.
Normalize machine slugs by lowercasing, trimming boundary whitespace, and converting each whitespace run to one hyphen.
Keep existing punctuation unchanged during slug generation.

citations.note: Defines display-label and machine-slug normalization behavior.

recipes: For a display label, retain the original Unicode text.
For a machine slug: lowercase the input, strip boundary whitespace, replace each run of whitespace with a single hyphen, and leave punctuation intact.

citations.note: Defines the paging threshold, reset rule, and missing-probe semantics.

recipes: Implement a counter that increments on failure, pages at three consecutive failures, and resets to zero on success.
Handle missing probes as an explicit unknown state; leave the failure counter unchanged.

themes: Retention management: preserve the 24 most recent snapshots.
Recovery validation: perform monthly restore drills on the first Tuesday.

citations.note: Defines the complete backup cadence, retention limit, and restore-drill schedule.

recipes: To schedule backups, trigger snapshot creation every six hours and enforce retention by deleting snapshots older than the 24 most recent.
To validate recoverability, schedule a restore drill for the first Tuesday of each month and document its outcome.

themes: Scheduled deployment coordination: target 06:20–06:40 UTC for normal releases.
Emergency change authorization: require both an incident reference and the current on-call engineer.
Rollback data integrity: preserve stored job history during recovery.

citations.note: Complete release-window, emergency-patch, and rollback requirements.

recipes: To schedule a normal deployment, select a time from 06:20 through 06:40 UTC.
To prepare an emergency patch, record the incident reference and current on-call engineer first.
To roll back safely, verify stored job history remains available before and after recovery.

citations.note: Requires text labels alongside color for all status indicators and keyboard access to task details without traversing the entire graph canvas.

recipes: For each status indicator, pair the color cue with a text label; see product/accessibility.md:3.
For graph-based task views, provide a direct keyboard-reachable task-detail path; see product/accessibility.md:3.

themes: Sibling workflow navigation via a local map.

citations.note: Defines ancestry breadcrumbs, sibling workflow maps, and preserved map position.

recipes: For scope navigation, render a breadcrumb for ancestry and a local workflow map for siblings; see product/navigation.md:3.
For node inspection, open details in a way that preserves the workflow-map position; see product/navigation.md:3.

themes: Credential metadata: record identifier and provider

citations.note: Defines the complete logging and configuration-export secret-handling rule.

recipes: When instrumenting a job, log the credential identifier and provider fields only; redact or exclude the credential value.
When exporting configuration, omit all secret values while retaining non-secret settings and credential metadata.

citations.note: Defines the session lifetime and activity-refresh rules.

recipes: Expire a session when its inactivity duration reaches 42 minutes.
On each successful authenticated request, update the session activity timestamp.
Leave the activity timestamp unchanged after failed authentication.
